scope: One controlled email sign-in submission in a newly created Chrome tab to the current private personal-schedule origin. The prior controlled test identity was used only in memory and no identifier, password, browser storage, cookie, profile, or mail content was recorded.

interpretation.proven: The current private origin rendered the normal Chrome email sign-in form and returned an application-level neutral authentication failure after exactly one controlled submission. The replay stopped without retrying credentials, password recovery, Google account selection, or any business mutation.
not_proven: Whether the controlled credential was stale, unverified, or otherwise rejected
A successful ordinary-browser authenticated mutation or history readback
interpretation.decision: Do not enumerate credentials or reset a password through automation. A future ordinary-browser mutation replay requires a freshly verified, controlled test identity with a known current credential.
